init.title: Area Averages options
init.description: One average sensor per area, per sensor type. Membership follows the entity registry, so anything you move into an area is picked up automatically.

data.stale_hours: Flag a sensor as stale after (hours)
data.exclude_label: Label that excludes a sensor from averages

data_description.device_classes: An average is created for every area that has at least one sensor of the selected types. Turning a type off removes its averages, including their history.
data_description.stale_hours: Measured from a member's last numeric report, not from its last change — a sensor repeating the same value is not stale. Stale members are dropped from the average. A member that has never reported a number is listed as offline instead of stale, because there is no report to age.
data_description.battery_threshold: Members whose device has a battery level at or below this are listed in the issue attribute. Binary low-battery sensors are always reported.
data_description.trend_minutes: How far back the rising / falling / steady reading looks. Held in memory only, so the trend reads unknown for the first quarter hour after a restart.
data_description.exclude_label: The label applies to an entity OR to its device — labelling the device excludes every measurement that device reports. Excluded sensors stay visible on the dashboard under "Not in average"; they are simply not counted.
